description: A fake Composio Gmail. The search returns a week of support mail (2026-11-09 to 16): five threads on CSV export timing out (one with a second message and the team's SENT reply), three on an SSO login loop (one a 200-person lockout with a phone number), two on a double charge (one threatening a chargeback), one dark-mode request, a newsletter and an out-of-office. The search answers metadata only (a 200-character preview, no body); GMAIL_FETCH_MESSAGE_BY_MESSAGE_ID answers each message's full text by id.
